afg_reading_cancelled.title: Reset instruments
afg_reading_cancelled.text:
Before the first test point every instrument is reset to its default settings.

Unit under test that will be reset: MDO4000C.

Resetting a unit under test can ERASE settings stored on it (set-ups, configuration, preferences). Save anything you need from it first.

Reset the instruments and start?

afg_reading_cancelled.title: Self test
steps: Disconnect everything from the oscilloscope inputs.
The oscilloscope must have been running continuously for at least 20 minutes.

afg_reading_cancelled.title: Cycle power
steps: The manual requires the power to be cycled after the diagnostics. Switch the oscilloscope OFF, wait 10 seconds, switch it ON and wait for it to boot.
Press Continue when the front panel is ready. The program will reconnect over USB.

afg_reading_cancelled.title: Signal path compensation
steps: Disconnect everything from the oscilloscope inputs (including the RF input).
The oscilloscope must have been operating for 20 minutes. SPC takes 5 to 15 minutes; repeat it if the temperature changes by more than 10 degrees C.

afg_reading_cancelled.title: Input impedance - CH1
steps: Remove all other cables and terminators from the oscilloscope inputs.
Fluke 5560A SCOPE connector directly to the CH1 input (the 5560A is switched to its resistance-measurement function).
afg_reading_cancelled.caution: Do not connect anything else to the input while measuring resistance.

afg_reading_cancelled.title: 250 kΩ termination
steps: Push Utility, then Utility Page, then Self Test.
Push the "250 kΩ Termination Verification" lower-bezel button, then the CH side-bezel button to enable the channel.
Set the vertical scale to 100 mV/div.

Set the vertical scale to 100 mV/div.
